title: Why You Can Instantly Spot a Fake Smile
hook: You can instantly tell a fake smile from a real one.

narration.text: You can instantly tell a fake smile from a real one.
It is all in the eyes, not the mouth.
Real smiles, called Duchenne smiles, engage your eye muscles.
This creates tiny creases, or crow's feet, around the eyes.
Fake smiles only use the mouth muscles.
Next time, watch people's eyes to see if they are genuinely happy.
Try it right now, and tell me if you can spot a genuine smile in the comments.

description: Ever wondered how you instinctively know if a smile is real or fake? It turns out your brain is a brilliant detector of genuine emotion, and it is all thanks to a tiny detail around the eyes.
topic: Why your brain can instantly tell if someone is genuinely smiling or faking it. Watch people's eyes, not just their mouths.
